_comment: Paired recipe-knob env for the otr_16gb_ltx_audio_in preset (video-tiers). ltx23_low_audio_in is the public menu id of the EXISTING ltx_audio_in / eng_ltx_av IA2V engine (unchanged internally); it was ltx23_16gb_audio_in until lane 7 (2026-08-11) retired the vramtier token, and that older string still resolves through _LEGACY_ENGINE_ALIASES; OTR_ENABLE_LTX_AV is that engine's PRE-EXISTING enable flag (NOT a new gate). A launcher CLEARS the prior-tier key set, exports these, then boots + loads workflows/otr_canonical.json + applies the profile in memory (never this preset as the workflow). The audio conditions the video; OTR_MasterAudioMux keeps the OTR master audio authoritative.
